test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

The flood situation in the eastern region of the country remain grim for the fifth day today.
solution: The correct answer is **'remain grim'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'remains grim'** should be used instead of **'remain grim'.** • According to the** 'subject-verb agreement' **rule, the main verb in a sentence should be used on the basis of the **subject**. • In the given sentence,** 'the flood situation' **is the main **subject** that is **singular**. • Hence, **a singular helping verb** should be used. **Correct Sentence:__ ***The flood situation in the eastern region of the country **remains **grim for the fifth day today.* ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ **'remain grim' **के स्थान पर** 'remains grim' **का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • **'subject-verb agreement' **नियम के अनुसार वाक्य में **main verb** का प्रयोग **subject** के आधार पर करना चाहिए। • दिए गए वाक्य में **'the flood situation'** मुख्य **subject** है जो **singular** है। • इसलिए, एक **singular helping verb **का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए। 2f:T847, Here the correct answer is **Praise**.
